annotations.title: Deterministic Relational Seed Data & SQL Mock Fixture Generator

description: Generates deterministic relational test seed fixtures respecting foreign key constraints, unique indexes, and data bounds. Use when provisioning mock database datasets for automated testing, staging environments, or sandbox demos; for compiling ORM models from schemas, use generate_orm_models instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'schema_ddl' ('fixture_volume' defaults to 'minimal_smoke_test_5'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

deterministic_seed.description: Integer seed for reproducible pseudo-random data generation.

fixture_volume.description: Mock dataset volume profile: minimal smoke test (5), standard dataset (50), or stress dataset (500).

schema_ddl.description: Target database schema DDL defining tables, column types, and foreign key relations.

name: synthesize_seed_fixtures

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for synthesize_seed_fixtures.

foreign_keys_satisfied.description: True if all foreign key dependencies and unique constraints were verified valid.

records_generated_per_table.description: Count of generated records partitioned by target table name.

sql_inserts.description: Executable SQL INSERT statements populated with realistic mock records.
